keyEvents.text: Goal! Atletico Madrid 1, Viking 0. Alexander Sørloth (Atletico Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Alejandro Grimaldo.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 2, Viking 0. Julián Alvarez (Atletico Madrid) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Atletico Madrid 2, Viking 0.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Pablo Barrios replaces Álex Baena.
Gianni Stensness (Viking) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Giuliano Simeone replaces Julián Alvarez.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Jonathan David replaces Lee Kang-In.
Substitution, Viking. Peter Christiansen replaces Simen Kvia-Egeskog.
Substitution, Viking. Vetle Auklend replaces Henrik Heggheim.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Morten Hjulmand replaces Koke.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Rodrigo Mendoza replaces Alexander Sørloth because of an injury.
Substitution, Viking. Niklas Fuglestad replaces Herman Haugen.
Substitution, Viking. Amin Cosic replaces Tobias Moi.
Substitution, Viking. Joe Bell replaces Kristoffer Askildsen.
Henrik Falchener (Viking) is shown the red card.
Second Half ends, Atletico Madrid 2, Viking 0.
